headline: Congress named the Postal Service building at 400 N. Main Street in Encinal, Texas, the "Encinal Veterans Post Office."
what_it_does: This law gives an official name to a U.S. Postal Service facility in Encinal, Texas. The building is now designated the "Encinal Veterans Post Office." The law does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the facility operates.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2018.
